_about.chapter: Places: every map's size, floors, walls, zones, landmarks and ways in and out; the rooms and doors inside them; where the city's landmark blocks are; the fireplaces; and where the dyer stands.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON, inlined by tools/build.mjs as GAME_DB.places and checked by tools/test-game-db.cjs. Positions and sizes are world px, from the map's top-left; angles radians. Keys in camelCase or UPPER_SNAKE are read by the code under those names. Map ids and room ids are in save files and story steps: never rename one. _about.notes keeps the explanations that were comments in the code, keyed by where they apply (maps.apt_949.cameraBounds, rooms.apt_949.doors[0], …); they're for people only.

tables.maps: Every map (MAP_DATA, world/maps.js): id, width and height, type (outdoor, indoor), label, floorColor, spawn, and its floorZones, zones, walls, landmarks and transitions (a transition's target is another map's id). engine/map-loading.js builds the city's streets, buildings and props on top and fills each map's lists when it loads. A floor zone can name an area (hub_graveyard) instead of giving its own x, y, w and h.
tables.rooms: The rooms inside a map (ROOM_DEFS, world/rooms.js, passed to RoomSystem.build when the map loads): each map's rooms (x, y, w, h, type, label, fill), doors (sliding, hinged or arch, between two rooms), and windows.
tables.hub: The city (sdc): blocks says which block each landmark stands on (HUB_BLOCKS; the Silver Queen and the Double Nights stay in the north-west corner, block_0_0 and block_0_2); graveyard is the graveyard's rectangle (HUB_GRAVEYARD: engine/map-loading.js builds it, and its music, candle glow, ghosts and Ms. Jean go by it); ollo_door is the OllO Plaza door (HUB_OLLO_DOOR); npc_anchors are the people who stand on the hub, each keeping npc_clearance px free of buildings (HUB_NPC_ANCHORS, HUB_NPC_CLEARANCE).
tables.hearths: The fireplaces (HEARTHS, core/config.js), per map: where the art draws the fire, and where the ambience hears it crackle.
tables.dyer_station: Where the Clothing Dyer stands once it's crafted (DYER.STATION, engine/dyer.js): x, y, width and height in apt_949.

notes.maps.hotel_lobby: Double Nights Hotel — "Think excellence, think Double Nights." A grand interdimensional hotel: black marble and gold, a rift fountain, a chandelier over the twin crescents, guests and AI staff coming and going (directory/lobby-life.js). Floor: drawLobbyInterior; glows, the motto and the elevator doors: drawLobbyGlow; furniture: dn_* (props-decor.js).

notes.maps.hotel_lobby.navProps: the crowd walks round the furniture (lamps and palms too)
notes.maps.keepers_hill: The Double Nights penthouse — the Dark Maker's suite, left with a flourish. Furniture: createMapEntities (ps_*, drawSuiteDecorProp); floors: drawSuiteInterior; glows and the mirror rift he left through: drawSuiteGlow. Living room (elevator, pit, piano, bar, dining for two) | Bedroom (L) | Bath (the rift) | Balcony (pool) — the breach wall The prologue's fireside (engine/keeper-art.js paints both; story/scenes/prologue.js plays them)

notes.maps.church_boss.navProps: The Sanctum, open to the storm: the apse (dais, altar, rose window, ruined organ) where the Triumvirate kneel; the nave and its gold sigil (the arena); pillared aisles for cover; the narthex at the door. Furniture: sc_* (drawSanctumDecorProp); floor: drawSanctumInterior; glows: drawSanctumGlow and the wardens' eyes (drawBossGlow).
notes.maps.enni_cole_interior: Enni Cole, ground floor: a double-height lobby under the crystal chandelier, the grand staircase up to the salons at its head, Fashion and the Food Hall to the west, Electronics and Furniture to the east, each its own room behind a wide arch (world/rooms.js). Floor: _paintEnniFloor; chandelier and pendants: drawEnniGlow; displays: drawEnniDecorProp (ec_*). Food Hall | | Furniture -----------| Lobby + staircase |----------- Fashion | (chandelier) | Electronics

notes.maps.enni_cole_upper: Enni Cole, upper floor: the gallery round the lobby's void (the chandelier hangs in it), the couture showroom in the curved glass over the entrance under a ceiling of tiny lights, the Cuisine restaurant and its kitchen to the west, the accessories salon and fitting rooms east. Floor: _paintEnniUpperFloor; lights: drawEnniUpperGlow; displays: drawEnniDecorProp (ec_*).
notes.maps.cozy_cafe_interior.id: The Cozy Cafe: honey herringbone under pendant lamps, a brick hearth with armchairs, round candlelit tables, booths along the east wall, window benches either side of the door. Floor in drawCafeInterior, furniture in drawCafeDecorProp (cc_*), glow in drawCafeGlow.

notes.maps.auto_shop.id: Torque Auto: a graphite epoxy service bay with two lifts and the wrap bay, a black porcelain showroom with the plinth and the counter, the parts room on diamond plate. notes.rooms.hotel_suite: ── The rest of the indoor maps ───────────────────────────────────────── Penthouse suite (hotel): the living room opens west–east through a wide arch; a lounge wraps the bathroom (L-shaped); glass doors onto the balcony.
notes.rooms.cozy_cafe_interior: Cozy café: the floor wraps round the kitchen (north-east) and the storeroom (south-east), each now behind a door — the kitchen used to be sealed, Chef Koda out of reach.
notes.rooms.auto_shop: Torque Auto: the bay, the showroom through an open bay door, the parts room behind its own door.
notes.rooms.enni_cole_interior: Enni Cole: the lobby under the chandelier, a department behind a wide arch in each corner; upstairs the gallery, the couture showroom, the Cuisine restaurant (its kitchen behind a swing door) and the accessories salon (its fitting rooms behind another).
notes.rooms.neural_sys_interior: Neural Systems: the showroom, a small foyer at the door, the consultation and server rooms off it.
notes.rooms.hotel_lobby: One-room interiors: no veil to draw, but they share the room lighting (eased lamps, lightAt), and any doors they gain later take bullets and block sight.
notes.rooms.moon_city_nightclub: Moon City Nightclub: the hall and its bar, powder room and gents off the bar, the foyer, and the VIP wing (a curtained corridor, three suites, Mirabel's lounge at its head). Velvet drapes hung either side of the way into the VIP wing
notes.rooms.demoness_palace: The House of Death (gauntlet). Three loops round the grand hall, so no one gets cornered: foyer–kitchen–dining–hall, foyer–gallery–courtyard–hall, dining–library–chapel–bedroom–courtyard. a red moon through the throne hall's oculus, rose glass in the galleries crimson silks hanging in the galleries oxblood leaves (light enough to read), violet glass
